# TikTok

> > TikTok is a short-form video platform with comprehensive business solutions for advertising, creator partnerships, and social commerce, alongside robust safety and privacy features.

TikTok offers businesses access to Ads Manager, Creator Marketplace, and Shop integrations for marketing campaigns, while providing users with safety tools, parental controls, and community guidelines. The platform serves advertisers, creators, and consumers across multiple regions with localized support and resources.

## Key Topics

- TikTok for Business
- Ads Manager
- TikTok Shop

- Hashtag Challenges

- [TikTok for Business | Marketing & Advertising on TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG): TikTok for Business main hub: advertising platform for businesses and creators

## Case Studies & Success Stories

- [Parc Asterix | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/parc-asterix-202): Parc Asterix case study: launching official TikTok account and raising brand engagement
- [Mango | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/mango-188): Mango case study: generating awareness among young Spanish audience on TikTok
- [TOA Paint Group | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/toa-paint-group-316): TOA Paint Group case study: driving awareness for paint colors in Thailand market
- [Planswell | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/planswell-308): Planswell case study: connecting with ad-fatigued audiences through authentic content
- [Coconut Lane | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/coconut-lane-273): Coconut Lane case study: driving conversions and sales through Shopify integration
- [Up | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/up-347): Up case study: building brand awareness and love with Spark Ads
- [BiGDUG | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/bigdug-237): BiGDUG case study: building B2B brand awareness through creator collaboration
- [Tzuki Indonesia | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/tzuki-indonesia-228): Tzuki Indonesia case study: engaging consumers through native experiences on TikTok
- [Lactacyd | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/lactacyd-376): Lactacyd case study: boosting brand awareness in Vietnam through hashtag challenges
- [VYS Games | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/vys-games-206): VYS Games case study: creating authentic interest around mobile game launch
- [Amazon Prime Video Italy | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/amazon-prime-video-italy-219): Amazon Prime Video Italy case study: boosting awareness with Christmas campaign

## Safety & User Protection

- [Our approach to safety](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en/our-approach-to-safety): TikTok's safety principles, features, and privacy settings for user protection
- [Guardian's Guide](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-sg/guardians-guide): Guide for parents on TikTok tools, controls, and internet safety best practices
